text:
alex_k: quick check — noticed a few downstream services blew up when we toggled the v2 header validation in canary. who owns the client migration for internal-facade?

maria_g: that's on me for the facade surface, but i thought platform libs would handle header backwards-compat? any failing endpoints?

alex_k: the failing ones are /generate and /chat when callers send older client metadata; they hit strict schema in v2. minimal repro:

```
# curl example
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"xsmall","input":"hi"}' https://redwood/api/v2/generate
```

response: 400 with "unknown header: client-sdk-version"

ravi_p: hmm - that sounds like the header check gate we added in runtime (PR #4212). the gate enforces SDK header format for routing to v2 optimized kernels. if callers send legacy header we should route to compatibility shim instead.

jamie_l: we have a compatibility shim but it's only enabled for hosted API; looks like dedicated pools didn't get the shim config. @maria_g can you confirm config rollout?

maria_g: confirmed — dedicated clusters were excluded by mistake in the 2026-02 rollout. i can flip that, but want signoff from eng-runtime since there are perf implications.

alex_k: perf hit is ~6-8% for certain sequences, but keeps apps alive. i vote enable shim on dedicated for now and run a targeted perf test on a subset of clusters.

ravi_p: agree. proposed plan: 1) enable shim on dedicated clusters (maria) 2) add a small routing fallback in runtime to treat missing/legacy headers as legacy route (ravi) 3) ship SDK patch that warns clients (jamie) 4) run canary for 24h and monitor error rate/cost (alex)

jamie_l: SDK patch already drafted in client-js PR #887. it emits a console.warn if header not present and auto-sets backwards-compatible header for 30 days. can cut patch once runtime fallback merges.

maria_g: i'll enable the shim on one dedicated pool now, monitor, then roll. enabling in config UI: 2min.

deploy-bot: deploy started for config-change on cluster-dedicated-03 — cfg-change-id=cfg-2026-169.

sre-bot: alert rule "api.v2.request_errors" suppressed for cluster-dedicated-03 for 1h while rolling.

alex_k: thanks. owners for followups: runtime routing (ravi), facade client migrations (maria), client SDK release (jamie), canary metrics dashboard (alex). i'll create a short checklist in the handbook and tag you all.

maria_g: noted. i'll post config audit and the timing in #eng-infra once rollout completes.

ravi_p: will open a small PR to add the legacy-header fallback and include unit tests + a perf microbenchmark. target merge today EOD.

jamie_l: once runtime PR merged i'll cut SDK canary (patch release) and circulate release notes. ping me if you want a holdback window. :thumbsup:

alex_k: perfect — thanks everyone. we'll reconvene async if metrics spike.
